thread:
maya: Quick heads-up 1: starting a full cross-quant bakeoff today (AWQ / GPTQ / FP8 / INT8). Need a compact canary + shadow + fallback playbook that covers hosted, dedicated, and private.
raul: Sounds good. What's the traffic plan and pass/fail criteria?
maya: Plan: smoke on internal only, then shadow on 2% live traffic for 8h, then canary ramp: 0.2% -> 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Hold windows: short early, longer at larger pct. We want both per-route and folded metrics.
samir: Proposed hold times: 15m@0.2%, 1h@1%, 3h@10%, 6h@50%. Abort immediate on safety gate failures.
anya: Define metrics now: chat acceptability delta <= 1.2% vs baseline; code synthesis unit pass delta <= 0.8%; embeddings cosine mean >= 0.997 of baseline. Also add precision probes for hallucination prompts.
raul: Add P95 and P99 latency SLOs: P95 <= baseline+12%, P99 <= baseline+25%. Also track error-rate absolute increase cap 0.3%.
maya: Rollout safety gates (draft):
```
rollout:
  phases:
    - pct: 0.2; hold: 15m
    - pct: 1; hold: 1h
    - pct: 10; hold: 3h
    - pct: 50; hold: 6h
    - pct: 100; hold: 24h
  gates:
    - metric: chat_accept_delta; max: 1.2
    - metric: code_pass_delta; max: 0.8
    - metric: embed_cosine_ratio; min: 0.997
    - metric: p99_latency; max_increase_pct: 25
    - metric: error_rate; max_absolute: 0.3
```
anya: For private deployments, mirror customer quant policy but default to FP8 on memory-constrained nodes and AWQ on tight-inference-cost nodes.
raul: Routing rules: hosted -> prefer lowest-latency quant variant, with automatic fallback to baseline float if gate trips. Dedicated -> prefer INT8 variant if available; if not, use AWQ. Private -> honor tenant overrides.
samir: Add deterministic rollback triggers: rolling window (30m) quality delta > threshold, P99 latency increase > 25%, error-rate > 0.3% absolute.
maya: Shadow config: collect full request/response pairs, no real responses returned to client, annotate traces with variant tag. For multi-variant comparison we do soft-weights in production for short A/B probes.
raul: We should implement sample-mining to upweight prompts where baseline fails. Reweight factor 3x for known-fail clusters, subject to reservoir sampling caps.
anya: Important: purge KV-cache between variant runs for fairness. Also freeze batching profiles during bakeoff to avoid warmup noise.
ci-bot: smoke-tests kicked off for bakeoff matrix (awq,gptq,fp8,int8) 1: logs: https://ci.redwood.local/9876 :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: canary rollout requested by maya at 1745600105. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and #eng-ml.
samir: After shadow run, run holdout evals and produce delta-table per-workload and per-route. Include sample-mined rows separately.
maya: I'll start internal smoke in 30m and enable shadow later today. Tag me for any additional probes. :rocket:
